title: Thai-Style Casserole
description: A fusion of Thai flavors with a casserole twist. A hearty, comforting dish that combines juicy chicken and savory tomato sauce.
instructions: Cook the Portuguese rice according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer while preparing the casserole.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked rice, diced juicy tomatoes, and fish sauce (if using).
Transfer the rice mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour the chicken and tomato sauce mixture over the rice mixture.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the sauce is bubbly.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
